My name is Ezra Tandela (or 陈主荣 in Chinese). I am a PhD student in the Department of Comparative Literature at Harvard University. I work on the literary and cultural history of twentieth century in East Asia. My ongoing interests include: the history of the decolonial movement among Asian creatives from the 1950s to the 1970s, the transmission of Confucian classics in education broadcasts of post-war Japan, and travel writing in early twentieth century East Asia.
